analysis: Post hoc diagnostic analysis of the eight observed server/local disagreements
population: All 200 frozen queries; eight disagreements are the focus, 192 agreements supply descriptive context.
questions: Can all original inputs, server labels, model hashes, and local predictions be replayed?
At which stage does each disagreement occur, and how near is its local score to zero relative to scores at the same stage?
Do independent scalar feature calculations, direct RBF evaluation, or input feature float32 quantization change local signs?
How sensitive are final labels to the four already documented feature conventions, using the same frozen primary models?
Are the eight unusual in elementary composition or training-sequence similarity relative to the other queries?
limitations: Exploratory post hoc diagnostics, not an independent validation or causal explanation.
Uncalibrated decision values are not probabilities and are compared only within the same local classifier.
Feature variants perturb inference inputs to primary-trained support vectors; these are not complete retrained alternative pipelines.
No variant or threshold will be adopted by matching server labels.
The author server supplies labels but not feature vectors, model coefficients, numerical scores, or a complete training history.
Composition descriptions do not identify functional motifs or biological activity.
